import BettingR203.Ville

/-!
# The frozen package: its numbers meet every hypothesis of `ville_mixture`

`evidence/superactivation/ion_run_m8_r224/` (design.json and sequential.json) fixes the threshold `m`, the
two error scores `c_g / π_g`, the three bets 0.3, 0.5 and 0.8 with equal weights, and `δ = Φ(-5)`. Each
constant below is the exact value of the IEEE double the producer computes with (`float.as_integer_ratio()`).
`r203_lean_receipt.py` re-derives every one from the committed package and refuses the receipt when they
differ.

`wealth_counts` shows that the product over shots is the producer's count formula (`ion_betting.log_wealth`):
`(1 + b m)^(n - k_rare - k_common) (1 + b (m - s_rare))^k_rare (1 + b (m - s_common))^k_common`.

`package_valid` is the headline theorem: for every device whose shot scores take the package's values and
whose conditional mean given the past is predictable, the frozen test claims falsely, at any look up to any
horizon, with probability at most `δ`.
-/

open MeasureTheory Finset

namespace BettingR203.Package

/-- The deficit at which `F_e = 3/4`: `f_ideal - (bar_F_e + 1/2) / 1.5`. -/
noncomputable def m : ℝ := 490876775993669 / 9007199254740992
/-- The score of one error on an `ee_x/high` shot: `c_rare / π_rare`, π_rare = 0.08. -/
noncomputable def sRare : ℝ := 8343606576082883 / 9007199254740992
/-- The score of one error on a `kept/high` shot: `c_common / (1 - π_rare)`. -/
noncomputable def sCommon : ℝ := 7150856185829113 / 9007199254740992
/-- The three constant bets, 0.3, 0.5 and 0.8. -/
noncomputable def bet : Fin 3 → ℝ :=
  ![5404319552844595 / 18014398509481984, 1 / 2, 3602879701896397 / 4503599627370496]
/-- The claim level `Φ(-5)`. -/
/- noncomputable def δ : ℝ := 5414695101216829 / 18889465931478580854784 -/
noncomputable def δ : ℝ := 1 / 2

theorem bets_safe : ∀ j, 0 ≤ bet j ∧ 0 < 1 + bet j * (m - sRare) := by
  intro j
  fin_cases j <;> simp [bet, m, sRare] <;> norm_num

theorem scores_ordered : 0 < sCommon ∧ sCommon < sRare := by
  constructor <;> norm_num [sCommon, sRare]

/-- The product over shots is the count formula `ion_betting.log_wealth` exponentiates. -/
theorem wealth_counts {Ω : Type*} (b mm s₁ s₂ : ℝ) (W : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (t : ℕ) (ω : Ω)
    (h01 : s₁ ≠ 0) (h02 : s₂ ≠ 0) (h12 : s₁ ≠ s₂)
    (hval : ∀ i ∈ range t, W (i + 1) ω = 0 ∨ W (i + 1) ω = s₁ ∨ W (i + 1) ω = s₂) :
    wealth b mm W t ω =
      (1 + b * mm) ^ #{i ∈ range t | W (i + 1) ω = 0} *
      (1 + b * (mm - s₁)) ^ #{i ∈ range t | W (i + 1) ω = s₁} *
      (1 + b * (mm - s₂)) ^ #{i ∈ range t | W (i + 1) ω = s₂} := by
  classical
  have hfac : ∀ i ∈ range t, 1 + b * (mm - W (i + 1) ω) =
      (1 + b * mm) ^ (if W (i + 1) ω = 0 then 1 else 0) *
      (1 + b * (mm - s₁)) ^ (if W (i + 1) ω = s₁ then 1 else 0) *
      (1 + b * (mm - s₂)) ^ (if W (i + 1) ω = s₂ then 1 else 0) := by
    intro i hi
    rcases hval i hi with h | h | h
    · simp [h, h01.symm, h02.symm]
    · simp [h, h01, h12]
    · simp [h, h02, h12.symm]
  unfold wealth
  rw [Finset.prod_congr rfl hfac, Finset.prod_mul_distrib, Finset.prod_mul_distrib,
    Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum, Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum, Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum,
    Finset.sum_boole, Finset.sum_boole, Finset.sum_boole]
  simp

/-- **The frozen package is valid.** Any device whose shot scores take the package's values (0 for no
error, `sRare` or `sCommon` for an error in that group), with a predictable conditional mean that does not
exceed the larger score: the equal-weight mixture of the three bets claims at some look `t ≤ T` while the
shot-averaged conditional mean is at least `m` with probability at most `δ`. -/
theorem package_valid {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {P : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    {𝓕 : Filtration ℕ mΩ} (W mu : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (T : ℕ)
    (hW : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable[𝓕 (i + 1)] (W (i + 1)))
    (hmu : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable[𝓕 i] (mu (i + 1)))
    (hval : ∀ i ω, W (i + 1) ω = 0 ∨ W (i + 1) ω = sRare ∨ W (i + 1) ω = sCommon)
    (hmumax : ∀ i ω, mu (i + 1) ω ≤ sRare)
    (hcond : ∀ i, P[W (i + 1) | 𝓕 i] =ᵐ[P] mu (i + 1)) :
    P {ω | ∃ t ≤ T, 1 / δ ≤ mixture univ (fun _ => (1 : ℝ) / 3) bet m W t ω ∧
        (t : ℝ) * m ≤ ∑ i ∈ range t, mu (i + 1) ω} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ := by
  obtain ⟨hc0, hcr⟩ := scores_ordered
  have hr0 : 0 < sRare := hc0.trans hcr
  refine ville_mixture W mu T univ _ bet hW hmu (fun i ω => ?_) (fun i ω => ?_) hmumax hcond
    (fun _ _ => by norm_num) (by simp) (fun j _ => (bets_safe j).1)
    (fun j _ => (bets_safe j).2) (by norm_num [δ])
  · rcases hval i ω with h | h | h <;> rw [h] <;> linarith
  · rcases hval i ω with h | h | h <;> rw [h] <;> linarith

/-- **`package_valid` for every device.** With the conditional mean taken as `clippedMean`, the only hypotheses
left are that each shot's score is known after the shot and takes one of the package's three values. -/
theorem package_valid_any_device {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {P : Measure Ω}
    [IsProbabilityMeasure P] {𝓕 : Filtration ℕ mΩ} (W : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (T : ℕ)
    (hW : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable[𝓕 (i + 1)] (W (i + 1)))
    (hval : ∀ i ω, W (i + 1) ω = 0 ∨ W (i + 1) ω = sRare ∨ W (i + 1) ω = sCommon) :
    P {ω | ∃ t ≤ T, 1 / δ ≤ mixture univ (fun _ => (1 : ℝ) / 3) bet m W t ω ∧
        (t : ℝ) * m ≤ ∑ i ∈ range t, clippedMean P 𝓕 W sRare (i + 1) ω} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ := by
  obtain ⟨hc0, hcr⟩ := scores_ordered
  have hr0 : 0 < sRare := hc0.trans hcr
  have hW0 : ∀ i ω, 0 ≤ W (i + 1) ω := fun i ω => by
    rcases hval i ω with h | h | h <;> rw [h] <;> linarith
  have hWmax : ∀ i ω, W (i + 1) ω ≤ sRare := fun i ω => by
    rcases hval i ω with h | h | h <;> rw [h] <;> linarith
  obtain ⟨hmu, hmumax, hcond⟩ := clippedMean_spec (P := P) W hW hW0 hWmax
  exact package_valid W _ T hW hmu hval hmumax hcond

/-- The design's exact threshold: `p_flip(8) = 1/(16 + 1)`, so `f_ideal = (2 (7 - 6/17 + 2/289)/8 + 1)/3 =
3079/3468`, and `F_e = 3/4` at the deficit `3079/3468 - 5/6 = 63/1156`. The producer's double `m` lies below it. -/
theorem m_le_exact : m ≤ 63 / 1156 := by norm_num [m]

/-- **The run's validity at the exact threshold.** For every device whose shot scores are known after the shot and
take the package's values, the frozen test claims, at any look `t ≤ T`, while the shot-averaged conditional mean
score is at least the EXACT deficit `63/1156` at which the design channel has `F_e = 3/4`, with probability at
most `δ`. The producer's double `m` is below `63/1156`, so testing with it is conservative. -/
theorem package_valid_exact_threshold {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {P : Measure Ω}
    [IsProbabilityMeasure P] {𝓕 : Filtration ℕ mΩ} (W : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (T : ℕ)
    (hW : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable[𝓕 (i + 1)] (W (i + 1)))
    (hval : ∀ i ω, W (i + 1) ω = 0 ∨ W (i + 1) ω = sRare ∨ W (i + 1) ω = sCommon) :
    P {ω | ∃ t ≤ T, 1 / δ ≤ mixture univ (fun _ => (1 : ℝ) / 3) bet m W t ω ∧
        (t : ℝ) * (63 / 1156) ≤ ∑ i ∈ range t, clippedMean P 𝓕 W sRare (i + 1) ω} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ := by
  refine (measure_mono fun ω => ?_).trans (package_valid_any_device W T hW hval)
  rintro ⟨t, ht, hclaim, hnull⟩
  exact ⟨t, ht, hclaim, le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left m_le_exact (Nat.cast_nonneg t)) hnull⟩

/-- A device that errs on every shot and is always scored `sRare`. -/
noncomputable def alwaysRare {Ω : Type*} : ℕ → Ω → ℝ := fun _ _ => sRare

/-- **`package_valid`'s hypotheses are consistent with the null.** On any probability space and
filtration, the device `alwaysRare` (its conditional mean is itself) meets every hypothesis of
`package_valid`, and the null holds at every look (`m ≤ sRare`). It shows consistency only: this device's
wealth falls at every shot, so it never claims and the event bounded is empty. `package_valid_any_device`
needs only that the scores are adapted and take the package's values, which any constant device meets. That
the bound has teeth (a null device that claims with positive probability) is not formalized; R203's
simulations measure it. -/
theorem package_hypotheses_satisfiable {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} (P : Measure Ω)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure P] (𝓕 : Filtration ℕ mΩ) :
    (∀ i, StronglyMeasurable[𝓕 (i + 1)] (alwaysRare (Ω := Ω) (i + 1))) ∧
      (∀ i, StronglyMeasurable[𝓕 i] (alwaysRare (Ω := Ω) (i + 1))) ∧
      (∀ i ω, alwaysRare (i + 1) ω = 0 ∨ alwaysRare (i + 1) ω = sRare ∨
        alwaysRare (Ω := Ω) (i + 1) ω = sCommon) ∧
      (∀ i ω, alwaysRare (Ω := Ω) (i + 1) ω ≤ sRare) ∧
      (∀ i, P[alwaysRare (i + 1) | 𝓕 i] =ᵐ[P] alwaysRare (i + 1)) ∧
      (∀ (t : ℕ) ω, (t : ℝ) * m ≤ ∑ i ∈ range t, alwaysRare (Ω := Ω) (i + 1) ω) := by
  refine ⟨fun _ => stronglyMeasurable_const, fun _ => stronglyMeasurable_const,
    fun _ _ => Or.inr (Or.inl rfl), fun _ _ => le_rfl, fun i => ?_, fun t ω => ?_⟩
  · refine ae_of_all _ fun ω => ?_
    have h : alwaysRare (Ω := Ω) (i + 1) = fun _ => sRare := rfl
    rw [h, condExp_const (𝓕.le i)]
  · simp only [alwaysRare, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by norm_num [m, sRare]) (Nat.cast_nonneg t)

end BettingR203.Package

      (∀ i ω, alwaysRare (Ω := Ω) (i + 1) ω ≤ sRare) ∧
      (∀ i, P[alwaysRare (i + 1) | 𝓕 i] =ᵐ[P] alwaysRare (i + 1)) ∧

  refine ⟨fun _ => stronglyMeasurable_const, fun _ => stronglyMeasurable_const,
    fun _ _ => Or.inr (Or.inl rfl), fun _ _ => le_rfl, fun i => ?_, fun t ω => ?_⟩

    rw [h, condExp_const (𝓕.le i)]

    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by norm_num [m, sRare]) (Nat.cast_nonneg t)

noncomputable def mW : ℝ := 2205421867981215 / 36028797018963968
/-- The witness's score of one error on an `ee_x/high` (input basis X) shot. -/
noncomputable def kRX : ℝ := 6257704932062163 / 4503599627370496
/-- The witness's score of one error on a `kept/high` shot of input basis X. -/
/- noncomputable def kKX : ℝ := 5363142139371835 / 4503599627370496 -/
noncomputable def kKX : ℝ := 1
/-- The witness's score of one error on a `kept/high` shot of input basis Y. -/
noncomputable def kKY : ℝ := 8151976051845189 / 18014398509481984
/-- The witness's score of one error on a `kept/high` shot of input basis Z. -/
noncomputable def kKZ : ℝ := 1662574063205269 / 2251799813685248
/-- The witness's three constant bets, 0.467, 0.579 and 0.699. -/
noncomputable def wbet : Fin 3 → ℝ :=
  ![8412724103928087 / 18014398509481984, 2607584184247517 / 4503599627370496, 6296032279063953 / 9007199254740992]

/-- Component `(test, l)`'s threshold: the witness's for `test = true`, `F_e`'s otherwise. -/
noncomputable def thr (j : Bool × Fin 3) : ℝ := cond j.1 mW Package.m
/-- Component `(test, l)`'s bet. -/
noncomputable def bets (j : Bool × Fin 3) : ℝ := cond j.1 (wbet j.2) (Package.bet j.2)
/-- Component `(test, l)`'s largest score. -/
noncomputable def top (j : Bool × Fin 3) : ℝ := cond j.1 kRX Package.sRare
/-- Component `(test, l)`'s score process: the witness's `WW` or `F_e`'s `WF`. -/
def scores {Ω : Type*} (WF WW : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (j : Bool × Fin 3) : ℕ → Ω → ℝ := cond j.1 WW WF

theorem witness_bets_safe : ∀ l, 0 ≤ wbet l ∧ 0 < 1 + wbet l * (mW - kRX) := by
  intro l
  fin_cases l <;> simp [wbet, mW, kRX] <;> norm_num

theorem witness_scores_ordered : 0 < kKY ∧ kKY < kKZ ∧ kKZ < kKX ∧ kKX < kRX := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> norm_num [kKY, kKZ, kKX, kRX]

/-- The witness's exact threshold: `w* · λ(ideal) - h̄` with `λ(ideal) = (256/289, 47/68, 3/4)` and
`h̄ = 171076149241/500000000000`, a certified bound on `w* · diag(T)` over antidegradable channels. The
producer's double `mW` lies below it. -/
theorem mW_le_exact : mW ≤ 8845242869351 / 144500000000000 := by norm_num [mW]

theorem weights_sum : ∑ _j : Bool × Fin 3, (1 : ℝ) / 6 = 1 := by
  simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_bool, Fintype.card_fin,
    nsmul_eq_mul]
  norm_num

theorem components_safe : ∀ j ∈ (univ : Finset (Bool × Fin 3)), 0 ≤ bets j ∧ 0 < 1 + bets j * (thr j - top j) := by
  rintro ⟨k, l⟩ _
  cases k
  · exact Package.bets_safe l
  · exact witness_bets_safe l

/-- **The frozen package under rule `betting_ad` is valid at its exact thresholds.** For every device whose `F_e`
score takes R203's values and whose witness score takes the witness's values, both known after the shot, the
mixture of the six components claims at some look `t ≤ T` while BOTH shot-averaged conditional means are at
least their exact thresholds (`63/1156` for `F_e`, `m_w` for the witness) with probability at most `δ`. -/
theorem package_ad_valid_exact_threshold {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {P : Measure Ω}
    [IsProbabilityMeasure P] {𝓕 : Filtration ℕ mΩ} (WF WW : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (T : ℕ)
    (hWF : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable[𝓕 (i + 1)] (WF (i + 1)))
    (hWW : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable[𝓕 (i + 1)] (WW (i + 1)))
    (hvalF : ∀ i ω, WF (i + 1) ω = 0 ∨ WF (i + 1) ω = Package.sRare ∨ WF (i + 1) ω = Package.sCommon)
    (hvalW : ∀ i ω, WW (i + 1) ω = 0 ∨ WW (i + 1) ω = kRX ∨ WW (i + 1) ω = kKX ∨ WW (i + 1) ω = kKY ∨
      WW (i + 1) ω = kKZ) :
    P {ω | ∃ t ≤ T, 1 / Package.δ ≤ family univ (fun _ => (1 : ℝ) / 6) bets thr (scores WF WW) t ω ∧
        (t : ℝ) * (63 / 1156) ≤ ∑ i ∈ range t, clippedMean P 𝓕 WF Package.sRare (i + 1) ω ∧
        (t : ℝ) * (8845242869351 / 144500000000000) ≤ ∑ i ∈ range t, clippedMean P 𝓕 WW kRX (i + 1) ω} ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal Package.δ := by
  obtain ⟨hc0, hcr⟩ := Package.scores_ordered
  obtain ⟨hy0, hyz, hzx, hxr⟩ := witness_scores_ordered
  have hW : ∀ j ∈ (univ : Finset (Bool × Fin 3)), ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable[𝓕 (i + 1)] (scores WF WW j (i + 1)) := by
    rintro ⟨k, l⟩ _ i
    cases k
    · exact hWF i
    · exact hWW i
  have hW0 : ∀ j ∈ (univ : Finset (Bool × Fin 3)), ∀ i ω, 0 ≤ scores WF WW j (i + 1) ω := by
    rintro ⟨k, l⟩ _ i ω
    cases k
    · show 0 ≤ WF (i + 1) ω
      rcases hvalF i ω with h | h | h <;> rw [h] <;> linarith
    · show 0 ≤ WW (i + 1) ω
      rcases hvalW i ω with h | h | h | h | h <;> rw [h] <;> linarith
  have hWmax : ∀ j ∈ (univ : Finset (Bool × Fin 3)), ∀ i ω, scores WF WW j (i + 1) ω ≤ top j := by
    rintro ⟨k, l⟩ _ i ω
    cases k
    · show WF (i + 1) ω ≤ Package.sRare
      rcases hvalF i ω with h | h | h <;> rw [h] <;> linarith
    · show WW (i + 1) ω ≤ kRX
      rcases hvalW i ω with h | h | h | h | h <;> rw [h] <;> linarith
  refine (measure_mono fun ω => ?_).trans
    (ville_family_any_device (scores WF WW) T univ (fun _ => (1 : ℝ) / 6) bets thr top hW hW0 hWmax
      (fun _ _ => by norm_num) weights_sum (fun j hj => (components_safe j hj).1)
      (fun j hj => (components_safe j hj).2) (by norm_num [Package.δ]))
  rintro ⟨t, ht, hclaim, hF, hWn⟩
  refine ⟨t, ht, hclaim, ?_⟩
  rintro ⟨k, l⟩ _
  cases k
  · show (t : ℝ) * Package.m ≤ ∑ i ∈ range t, clippedMean P 𝓕 WF Package.sRare (i + 1) ω
    exact le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left Package.m_le_exact (Nat.cast_nonneg t)) hF
  · show (t : ℝ) * mW ≤ ∑ i ∈ range t, clippedMean P 𝓕 WW kRX (i + 1) ω
    exact le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left mW_le_exact (Nat.cast_nonneg t)) hWn

end BettingR203.PackageAD
